hooks.prompt: Check if docs need updating before this git push. Run `git diff @{u}...HEAD --name-only` to see what files are new in this push (falls back to `git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only` if there is no upstream yet). Per CONTRIBUTING.md: if any files in cmd/ changed (commands or flags), README.md must be updated. If README looks stale, block the push and explain what needs updating. Otherwise allow the push.
